source: Q150 leave-one-out validation (same design as Q147/Q48). FOREARM: ct_vhf_forearm's 13 real muscles with a Z-Anatomy source mesh (extensor_pollicis_longus_r excluded, no Z-Anatomy source, same as Q147); all 13 recovered a claim. HAND: ct_vhf_hand's 6 real muscles; only 3 recovered a claim within 12mm of their own Q147 transferred seed inside vhf_hand_muscles_cryo.nii.gz (abductor_digiti_minimi_hand_r/flexor_digiti_minimi_brevis_hand_r/opponens_digiti_minimi_r did not -- their Q147 seed sits >12mm from the real muscle-tissue mask; scored at their UNCHANGED Q147 baseline distance, since that is what would actually ship).

forearm.shipped_as: xfer_zan2vhf_limb_refined (Q150), 4 female forearm structures actually shipped: anconeus_r, flexor_carpi_radialis_r, flexor_digitorum_superficialis_r, pronator_teres_r (from superficial_flexor_compartment / supinator_anconeus_compartment). supinator_r's refined claim was too small (<0.15x Q147's own volume) and is kept as Q147, unchanged; palmaris_longus_r has no Q147 seed at all (no Z-Anatomy source). See data/derived/refine_report_zan2vhf_limb.json.

hand.reason_not_shipped: half the held-out hand muscles could not be recovered at all within 12mm of their own Q147 seed (max after-refinement error 42.7mm, over the 30mm outlier bar) -- kept as Q147, unchanged, disclosed here rather than shipped on weak evidence.
